query:
SELECT ir.id, ir.userId, u.name, ir.completedAt,
  ir.domainN, ir.domainE, ir.domainO, ir.domainA, ir.domainC
FROM ipip_results ir
JOIN users u ON u.id = ir.userId
ORDER BY ir.completedAt DESC
LIMIT 5;
